reports.title: Amplitude Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter and full year 2026, the Company expects:

Fourth Quarter 2026 | Full Year 2026
Revenue | $110.8 - $113.2 million | $415.8 - $418.2 million

Non-GAAP Net Income Per Share, diluted | $0.05 - $0.06 | $0.07 - $0.09
